children: On September 1, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it was not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) for failing to timely file its Form 10-Q for the period ended June 30, 2026. The Form 10-Q was filed on September 1, 2026, and Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance on September 3, 2026. The notice had no immediate effect on the Nasdaq listing.
